title: Catwalk Queen Run 3D
description: Dash down glamorous 3D runway courses—pick stylish outfits, collect sparkling accessories, dodge messy mud traps, and strike a winning pose at the finale.
controls: Swipe left and right to steer along the runway, grab matching fashion items, and avoid obstacles.

zh-CN.title: 奔跑吧美少女 3D
zh-CN.description: 抖音超火 3D 变装跑酷美少女：在缤纷赛道收集时尚穿搭与闪耀配饰、躲避障碍陷阱，惊艳亮相终点 T 台拿下全场最高分！
zh-CN.controls: 左右滑动控制角色在赛道奔跑，挑选高分穿搭道具并避开障碍冲向终点。
